conditions.name: light
conditions.note: dimmer amber; the alcove swallows light a little as it swallows sound

conditions.name: water
conditions.note: NONE — dry, like the rest of the floor.

description: A side recess off the nave, its walls hung with rotted acoustic baffling — felt and horsehair, centuries old. Inside it, sound DIES. The hum cuts to nothing the moment you step in. A reader who notices the silence understands the whole floor.

things.name: rotted acoustic baffling (the alcove walls)
things.use: this is WHY the alcove is dead-silent — it eats sound. The Cantor is nearly mute in here (coordinator: the Cantor's ment attacks are halved or fail in/near the alcove). Tear panels free to carry a muffling baffle as a 'sound shield.'
things.note: the readable answer to the Cantor — fight FROM here, or drag the fight here, and its power collapses

things.name: a corpse in old robes (slumped in the corner)
things.use: a previous climber. Carries a SILVER WHISTLE (a single piercing note — strikes every resonance-plate at once for a deafening stagger, usable once or twice before the Cantor adapts) and a cracked focus-crystal (mind/affinity seed).
things.note: the whistle is a key item — turns the plates against the Cantor; reward for searching the silent room

things.name: scratched words on the wall (above the corpse)
things.use: a dying climber's note: 'IT SINGS THROUGH THE BRONZE — KILL THE BRONZE — THE STONE ONE ONLY WAKES AT THE ARCH.' Free lore-gate: tells a reader both weaknesses if they search here.
things.note: rewards exploration with the floor's solution stated plainly — but only if Alan thinks to enter the silent room
